audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a generic 'reassess'. The actual spike is the cooldown gap: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s against Noxian Guillotine's 120/100/80s, so at 6 you own an ult he does not.
audit.why: Kit cooldowns, both champions. The mirror audit put the same 100s-versus-120s line on Darius's page, so the two directions now state one fact.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and whys[4] carry the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'R cleanses his pull' is stated as fact in tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].t, whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[0]. Ragnarok cleanses nothing — it grants immunity to disables while it is active and Olaf keeps attacking. Pressed after Apprehend lands, it does not free you.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf R: 'become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.' There is no removal clause. This is the single instruction most likely to get a player killed on this page: it tells him to hold R for the pull, when the correct play is to have it up before Darius is in the 535 range. The mirror audit corrected the same framing from Darius's side.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with pre-emption — press it before the pull, never after — and Apprehend's real 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown attached, which also answers packet.defects ('NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere').

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W-omnivamp' / 'W sustain' in whys[3], whys[5], mid, late and wants.you[2]. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P). This matters here specifically because the Bramble Vest argument on the page rests on out-HEALING him, and the healing comes from the passive, not the W.
audit.corrected: Shield and Berserker Rage named correctly in all five.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in starts on the pull. R cleanses it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s, and his whole all-in starts on it. Ragnarok prevents the pull only if it is already up. - Crippling Strike: a 5s slow and auto-reset. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His all-in starts on the pull. R cleanses it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His all-in starts on the pull — 26s at rank 1. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in starts on the pull. R cleanses it. When it is down — Axe + E him.
edits.after: Track Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, and his whole all-in starts on it. Ragnarok prevents the pull, never removes it.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Darius contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Darius owns level 1: Apprehend drags you onto a bleed-stacked blade Q, and you have no Ragnarok to answer it yet.

edits.before: E true damage on cooldown is free, armor-proof chip. Only take the trade when Darius's Apprehend is down.
edits.after: Still his: Hemorrhage plus the blade half of Decimate out-damages a lone Q-slow before you have E.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Yours from 4: axe-reset slows behind the Tough It Out shield out-trade him, provided you never stand in five bleed stacks.

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok's 100s against his 120s is the gap that wins this lane — press it before Apprehend and nothing in his kit stops the run-down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine keeps scaling off his bleed while your flat true damage falls off — close it before the melee scrum is his.

edits.before: Short axe-reset trades into W-omnivamp keep you even, but his five-stack Noxian Might heal answers your sustain if you overstay.
edits.after: Short axe-reset trades behind the Tough It Out shield edge it your way — provided you never sit still in five Hemorrhage stacks.

edits.before: Ragnarok removes his E pull and bleed slow and makes you CC-immune — you all-in through his entire setup and E him down.
edits.after: Ragnarok's 100s beats his 120s: press it first and the pull cannot land, so you all-in through his setup and Reckless Swing him.

edits.before: Bramble's Grievous Wounds caps his Noxian Might healing so your W-omnivamp out-sustains the extended fight — even footing.
edits.after: Bramble's Grievous Wounds caps his Noxian Might healing, so Berserker Rage out-sustains the extended fight and you edge it.

edits.before: His R-execute true damage stays threatening while your flat true damage falls off, so neither of you clearly owns the late melee scrum.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine's true damage keeps scaling with his bleed while your flat true damage falls off — the late melee scrum is his.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses his E pull and bleed slow and makes you immune to his setup — your cleanest all-in window of the lane.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes you immune to Apprehend while you keep swinging — press it BEFORE the pull, and 6 is your cleanest all-in.

edits.before: Reach Level 6 and Ragnarok through his E pull and bleed slow to all-in CC-free
edits.after: Reach 6 and press Ragnarok before his pull lands, then all-in disable-free

edits.before: Buy Bramble Vest first to cut his Noxian Might healing and out-sustain with W-omnivamp
edits.after: Buy Bramble Vest first to cut his Noxian Might healing and out-sustain his bleed

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay a skill fight — short axe-reset trades into W sustain are fine, but never sit in five bleed stacks. Six is your moment: Ragnarok cleanses his E pull and bleed slow and makes you CC-immune, so all-in through his setup, slow him with Q, and burn E for the true damage while your passive ramps attack speed. That's the cleanest kill window you get against him.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt your way — short axe-reset trades behind the Tough It Out shield are fine, but never sit in five bleed stacks. Six is your moment: press Ragnarok BEFORE his 26s Apprehend, not after, and the pull cannot land while you keep swinging. Then slow with Q and burn Reckless Swing for the true damage as Berserker Rage ramps. That is the cleanest kill window you get.

edits.before: This evens back out at items — Bramble Vest is mandatory: its Grievous Wounds caps his Noxian Might healing so your W-omnivamp out-sustains him in the extended fight. Past two items his R-execute true damage stays relevant and you lose your flat-true-damage edge, so don't let it drag to a coinflip melee scrum at low HP where his execute beats you. Convert any 6-or-item lead into towers and dives before his bleed-and-execute pattern out-grinds yours.
edits.after: This tips his way at items — Bramble Vest is mandatory: its Grievous Wounds caps the Noxian Might healing so Berserker Rage's missing-health lifesteal can out-sustain him in the extended fight. Past two items Noxian Guillotine's true damage keeps scaling off his bleed while your flat true damage does not, so never let it drag to a low-HP melee scrum where his execute beats you. Convert any 6-or-item lead into towers and dives first.
